name: doudou
description: A round plush character about 1 body height tall. Its head and torso are one egg-shaped body. It has two short stubby arms with no elbows and no legs at all.

root_bounce.description: Whole character moves up (positive) or down. Can be used for hops.

root_sway.description: Whole character slides toward its left (positive) or right.

body_tilt.description: Body leans toward its left (positive) or right, pivoting at the bottom.

body_lean.description: Body leans forward (positive, toward the camera) or back.

body_twist.description: Body turns around its vertical axis.

squash.description: Squash (negative, wider and shorter) or stretch (positive, taller and thinner) with volume preserved.

arm_L_raise.description: Left arm lifts sideways: 0 hanging down, 90 horizontal, 170 overhead.

arm_L_forward.description: Left arm swings forward (positive) or back.

arm_R_raise.description: Right arm lifts sideways: 0 hanging down, 90 horizontal, 170 overhead.

arm_R_forward.description: Right arm swings forward (positive) or back.
